content: Messages are passed for $T$ time steps. Each step is implemented by a different layer of the MP network. Hence, iterations correspond to network depth. The final feature vector $\mathbf {h}_v^T$ of $v$ is based on messages propagated from all the nodes in the subtree of height $T$ rooted at $v$. It captures both the topology of the neighborhood of $v$ and the distribution of the vertex representations in it.
